author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager - Domains
job_description:
* R024187

* Pune, Maharashtra, India

* IT Operations

* Regular

  

**Location Details:**India, Remote

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time, others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.

This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings.

#### **Join our team**

GoDaddy, the world's largest domain name registrar, helps millions of entrepreneurs globally start, grow, and scale their businesses. People come to GoDaddy to name their idea, build a website and logo, sell their products and services, and accept payments. Airo™, our agentic operating system for small businesses, helps entrepreneurs get their idea online, run their business day-to-day, and grow through an integrated identity, presence, and commerce experience.

Domains are where many of those journeys begin. We have over 20 million customers and manage more than 80 million domains. Beyond registration, we run a domain aftermarket for investors and businesses that want to buy or sell a name. **Afternic** is one of the world's largest domain marketplaces, and GoDaddy Auctions is a leading marketplace for expired domains.

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll work on a range of customer problems for both independent entrepreneurs getting their business online and domain investors who buy and sell names at scale. Are you interested in this opportunity? We'd love to hear from you!

#### **What you'll get to do...**

* Own and deliver against your squad's Key Results, from problem framing through launch and readout. Learn fast. Ship frequently and set clear assessment criteria before you build
* Stay close to customers. Talk with them, review their feedback, and let their problems set your priorities
* Design and run experiments. Write clear hypotheses, partner with engineering and design to ship quickly, and interpret results honestly. Not every release will produce a statistically significant result. We expect you to find sound ways to measure what's hard to measure, so you know whether a release is moving your goals in the right direction and whether it hurts other key areas
* Use AI as a tool. Apply it to data analysis, UX design iteration, prototyping, and code where it fits, and apply your own judgment to the output
* Partner across time zones with engineering, design, marketing, and support. Communicate clearly in writing and keep decisions visible

#### **Your experience should include...**

* 6+ years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping measurable results
* Experience running A/B tests or other experiments from hypothesis to decision
* Adaptability and comfort with ambiguity and growth mindset that thrives on learning and continuous improvement – progress over perfection
* Skill in pulling relevant data yourself and interpreting it and practical AI fluency. You can describe where it helped you and where you chose not to rely on it
* Strong written and async communication, and comfort working with teammates that we have in other time zones with a focus on solving customer problems over shipping features

**You might also have...**

* Marketplace experience
* Experience with domains, web presence, or e-commerce
* Experience building for small business owners who are growing online
* Experience with financial or investing tools

*We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.*

**We've got your back...**We offer a range of total rewards that may include paid time off, retirement savings (e.g., 401k, pension schemes), bonus/incentive eligibility, equity grants, participation in our employee stock purchase plan, competitive health benefits, and other family-friendly benefits including parental leave. GoDaddy’s benefits vary based on individual role and location and can be reviewed in more detail during the interview process.

**About us...** GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing the help and tools to succeed online, making opportunity more inclusive for all. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights, and people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success. To learn more about the company, visit About Us.

At GoDaddy, we know diverse teams build better products—period. Our people and culture reflect and celebrate that sense of diversity and inclusion in ideas, experiences and perspectives. But we also know that’s not enough to build true equity and belonging in our communities. That’s why we prioritize integrating diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging principles into the core of how we work every day—focusing not only on our employee experience, but also our customer experience and operations. It’s the best way to serve our mission of empowering entrepreneurs everywhere, and making opportunity more inclusive for all. To read more about these commitments, as well as our representation and pay equity data, check out our Diversity and Pay Parity annual report which can be found on our Diversity Careers page.

We also embrace our diverse culture and offer a range of Employee Resource Groups (Culture). Have a side hustle? No problem. We love entrepreneurs! Most importantly, come as you are and make your own way.

*GoDaddy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer**.* *GoDaddy will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements.* *Refer to our full* *EEO policy.*

Our recruiting team is available to assist you in completing your application. If they could be helpful, please reach out to myrecruiter@godaddy.com.

**GoDaddy doesn’t accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies.**

author: Hiring Manager
title: Technical Product Owner II
job_description:
As a Technical Product Owner II here at Honeywell, you will lead and mentor a team of Technical Product Owners, providing strategic guidance and overseeing the entire product development lifecycle. Collaboration with cross-functional teams, including product managers and engineers, will be a key aspect of your role, ensuring a cohesive approach to product development. Your strategic influence will extend to driving innovation within the product management function, identifying opportunities for technological advancements, and actively participating in strategic decision-making to shape the overall direction of the Technical Product Owner team.

In this role, you will impact Honeywell's position at the forefront of technological advancements by driving efficient and timely product development, contributing to continuous improvement and innovation, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality products that meet customer needs.

  

YOU MUST HAVE

* 2+ years of experience in a Technical Product Owner management role or similar technical leadership position
* Mastery understanding of software development methodologies and processes
* Experience working in agile development environments and familiarity with agile principles
* Proven track record of successfully managing technical teams

WE VALUE

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or another related field.
* Certifications in product management or agile methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner).
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Attention to detail and excellent problem-solving capability

  

Key Responsibilities

* Collaborate with stakeholders to define and prioritize technical requirements
* Drive the development of technical specifications and ensure alignment with overall product strategy
* Provide technical guidance to the development team throughout the product lifecycle
* Work closely with the Technical Product Owner Manager to ensure timely and successful product delivery
* Actively participate in product planning and roadmap discussions

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Assistant Product Manager / Product Manager
job_description:
Product Management

Navi Mumbai (On-Site)

Associate, Mid-Senior

3-6 years

Fulltime

  

Job Description

**JD: Associate Product Manager (APM) / Product Manager (PM) | Small Hybrid Vertical**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Department:** Product Management

**Location:** Navi Mumbai

**Reports To:** Senior Product Manager

  
  

### **About Us**

At **ideaForge Technology**, we are pioneering the future of autonomous flight. We design, manufacture, and deploy cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) that solve complex challenges across industries—from defence, homeland security and infrastructure inspection to emergency response and delivery.

  
  

### **Role Summary**

As an Assistant Product Manager (APM) / Product Manager (PM) for the Small Hybrid Verticals portfolio within the Switch UAV family, you will own the product lifecycle, strategy, and market performance for this critical product line. You will report to the Senior Product Manager and operate as a leader within the product management function, bridging customer demand (defense, paramilitary, state agencies) with engineering capability, manufacturing constraints, and regulatory certification requirements.

This role blends strategic product development with hands-on execution across requirements, regulatory alignment (DGCA, FCC, BlueUAS Certification), business planning, and cross-functional team leadership. You will drive the product roadmap from market research through production at scale, managing trade-offs between performance, cost, compliance, and customer needs.

  
  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  
  

### **Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership**

* Develop and execute the multi-year product roadmap for Small Hybrid Verticals. Define product variants, performance tiers, and feature evolution across the Switch family. Work with engineering leadership to balance feature requests, technical feasibility, development timelines, and manufacturing capacity.

* Drive business cases for new initiatives (new variants, payload integrations, airframe configurations). Forecast revenue, unit economics, and market penetration for roadmap milestones.

### **Customer & Market Intelligence**

* Conduct ongoing market research across Indian defense buyers (Army Aviation, BRO, state police, paramilitary forces) and international defense bodies. Translate customer pain points and operational requirements into product requirements documents (PRDs).

* Lead competitive analysis of global and domestic UAV platforms operating in similar tactical niches. Track competitor capabilities, pricing, go-to-market strategies, and certifications.

* Support sales and business development teams with tender responses, feature positioning documents, and pricing justification. Participate in customer demonstrations and technical discussions to validate requirements.

### **Regulatory Certification & Compliance Leadership**

* Own the regulatory certification pathway for Small Hybrid Verticals through DGCA Type Certification and international regulatory bodies (FAA, EASA, etc.). Coordinate with certification teams, external agencies, and technology partners.

* Ensure product design, documentation, and testing align with aviation regulations. Prepare certification-readiness reports and mitigate compliance risks early in the development cycle.

* Manage dependencies with external regulatory bodies and escalate blockers to senior leadership.

### **Cross-Functional Program Leadership**

* Lead integrated product development programs with hardware (airframe, propulsion, avionics), electronics, software, and manufacturing teams. Facilitate requirements clarity, dependency tracking, and milestone achievement.

* Chair product review meetings, design reviews, and launch readiness gates. Escalate technical risks and resolve trade-offs between cost, performance, and timeline.

* Mentor junior product team members and interns. Provide guidance on requirements gathering, market analysis, and business case development.

### **Cost, Pricing & Business Performance**

* Conduct cost-of-goods analysis for Small Hybrid Verticals. Build bottom-up cost stacks including BOM, labor, overhead, and manufacturing yield. Identify cost-reduction opportunities across design, sourcing, and manufacturing.

* Define pricing strategy and margin targets in alignment with MoD procurement patterns, competitive positioning, and profitability objectives.

* Track product P&L, unit economics, and market performance against forecast. Provide monthly/quarterly business reviews to senior leadership.

### **Go-to-Market & Launch Strategy**

* Develop go-to-market plans for new variants or airframe configurations. Define launch messaging, positioning, channel strategy, and customer communication.

* Collaborate with sales, marketing, and customer success to prepare launch materials, data sheets, video content, and training documentation.

* Support contract negotiations and tender responses by providing technical specifications, performance claims, and regulatory compliance documentation.

  
  
  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor''s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication, Systems Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline.

* 3–5 years of product management, program management, or systems engineering experience in hardware-software integrated products (UAVs, aerospace, robotics, automotive, or defense systems).

* Demonstrated experience managing product lifecycle from concept through production, including involvement in design, testing, and field deployment.

* Strong technical aptitude. Ability to understand complex hardware and software architectures, flight dynamics, payload integration, and avionics. Comfortable reading design documentation, block diagrams, and engineering specifications.

* Excellent cross-functional communication skills. Proven ability to align engineering, manufacturing, sales, and leadership around product priorities.

* Analytical and data-driven mindset. Comfortable with financial modeling, cost analysis, and business case development.

* Familiarity with regulatory and certification frameworks (DGCA, FAA, EASA, or similar) and willingness to deepen expertise in aviation regulations.

* Strong organizational and project management skills. Track record of driving initiatives to completion in cross-functional environments.

  
  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Prior experience with UAV, drone, or autonomous systems design and development.

* Familiarity with Indian defense procurement processes, MoD acquisition cycles, and government buyer workflows.

* Experience working in defense, aerospace, or highly regulated hardware sectors.

* Knowledge of avionics, flight control systems, power systems, or payload integration challenges.

* Exposure to Agile or lean product development methodologies.

* Experience with manufacturing, supply chain, or cost optimization initiatives.

Skills

Product Management

Collaboration Building

Program Management

Analytic Problem Solving

Customer Interaction

Regulatory Knowledge

Systems Engineering Process

Data Analytics

title: Principal Product Manager - Digital Mfg.
job_description:
**Company Description**

**Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd.** is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because **Good Health Can’t Wait.**

We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency

Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

"

 **Job Description**

Job Summary

This role is for a Product Strategy & Delivery Leader, responsible for end-to-end product ownership across multiple strategic initiatives. The candidate will shape and execute product strategies, lead cross-functional development efforts, and ensure delivery aligns with business objectives, quality standards, and budget constraints.

" Roles & Responsibilities

* Develop and own the strategy for multiple assigned products, aligning them with overall business goals and market needs.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive product development, implementation, and ensure alignment across technical and business functions.
* Define product implementation roadmaps, establish clear timelines, milestones, and manage resources effectively.
* Assess the impact of changes on the ecosystem, drive necessary interventions and change management activities to ensure smooth transitions.
* Lead and mentor a team of product managers and professionals, fostering a high-performance culture and encouraging continuous learning.
* Drive continuous process simplification and business excellence, identifying areas for improvement and enabling sustainable efficiency.
* Ensure benefit realization of implemented products and projects, track success metrics, and optimize product outcomes.
* Identify operational risks and resolve critical issues, ensuring compliance, conducting root-cause analysis, and maintaining system integrity.

"

 **Qualifications**

**Educational Qualification:** Graduation in Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field is mandatory. MBA is preferred. Additional certifications such as Agile Transformation (Internal on PluralSight) and Certification of Capability in Business Analysis™ (CCBA®) are preferred.

**Minimum Work Experience:** 12+ years of experience.

**Skills & Attributes & Critical Exposures**

**Functional Skills:**

* Automation
* Artificial Intelligence
* Business Analytics
* DevOps
* Digital Product Management
* Prototyping
* Technology Strategy Development
* User Experience (UX) Design

**Resident Skills:**

* Change Management
* Digital Transformation
* Data Storytelling
* Design Thinking
* Data Analysis
* Program Management

**Behavioural Skills:**

* You lead with strategic foresight and decisiveness, ensuring product outcomes are both innovative and commercially viable.
* You cultivate collaboration and influence, enabling alignment across cross-functional teams, senior stakeholders, and delivery partners.
* You demonstrate resilience and accountability, navigating complexity with composure and maintaining ownership through challenges and change.

**Critical Exposures:**

* 4+ years’ experience as Product Manager in developing and executing digital product strategies across geographies / BUs in a global company is desired.
* Experience in managing digital product portfolios, applying design thinking process framework and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards is desired.

**Technical Exposures:**

* Experience with product management tools (e.g., JIRA, Aha!, Product Plan) is desired.
* Experience in Agile methodologies and development frameworks (e.g., Scrum, Kanban) is desired.
* Exposure to data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., SQL, Tableau) is preferred.

"

 **Additional Information**

Benefits Offered

At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.

The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.

" Our Work Culture

Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.

text:
**Company Description**

**Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd.** is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because **Good Health Can’t Wait.**

We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency

Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

"

 **Job Description**

Job Summary

This role is for a Product Strategy & Delivery Leader, responsible for end-to-end product ownership across multiple strategic initiatives. The candidate will shape and execute product strategies, lead cross-functional development efforts, and ensure delivery aligns with business objectives, quality standards, and budget constraints.

" Roles & Responsibilities

* Develop and own the strategy for multiple assigned products, aligning them with overall business goals and market needs.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive product development, implementation, and ensure alignment across technical and business functions.
* Define product implementation roadmaps, establish clear timelines, milestones, and manage resources effectively.
* Assess the impact of changes on the ecosystem, drive necessary interventions and change management activities to ensure smooth transitions.
* Lead and mentor a team of product managers and professionals, fostering a high-performance culture and encouraging continuous learning.
* Drive continuous process simplification and business excellence, identifying areas for improvement and enabling sustainable efficiency.
* Ensure benefit realization of implemented products and projects, track success metrics, and optimize product outcomes.
* Identify operational risks and resolve critical issues, ensuring compliance, conducting root-cause analysis, and maintaining system integrity.

"

 **Qualifications**

**Educational Qualification:** Graduation in Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field is mandatory. MBA is preferred. Additional certifications such as Agile Transformation (Internal on PluralSight) and Certification of Capability in Business Analysis™ (CCBA®) are preferred.

**Minimum Work Experience:** 12+ years of experience.

**Skills & Attributes & Critical Exposures**

**Functional Skills:**

* Automation
* Artificial Intelligence
* Business Analytics
* DevOps
* Digital Product Management
* Prototyping
* Technology Strategy Development
* User Experience (UX) Design

**Resident Skills:**

* Change Management
* Digital Transformation
* Data Storytelling
* Design Thinking
* Data Analysis
* Program Management

**Behavioural Skills:**

* You lead with strategic foresight and decisiveness, ensuring product outcomes are both innovative and commercially viable.
* You cultivate collaboration and influence, enabling alignment across cross-functional teams, senior stakeholders, and delivery partners.
* You demonstrate resilience and accountability, navigating complexity with composure and maintaining ownership through challenges and change.

**Critical Exposures:**

* 4+ years’ experience as Product Manager in developing and executing digital product strategies across geographies / BUs in a global company is desired.
* Experience in managing digital product portfolios, applying design thinking process framework and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards is desired.

**Technical Exposures:**

* Experience with product management tools (e.g., JIRA, Aha!, Product Plan) is desired.
* Experience in Agile methodologies and development frameworks (e.g., Scrum, Kanban) is desired.
* Exposure to data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., SQL, Tableau) is preferred.

"

 **Additional Information**

Benefits Offered

At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.

The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.

" Our Work Culture

Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.

For more details, please visit our career website at https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/"

title: Associate Product Manager, University Graduate, 2027 Start
job_description:
This role will begin accepting applications on October 30, 2026, targeting cohort starts between April and August 2027*.* You must complete your application \*before\* end of day on November 24, 2026 to be considered. Thank you in advance for your patience while our team reviews all applications. All applicants will be notified by the end of Spring 2027 with an update.

* + In the “Resume" section, attach an updated CV or resume. No cover letter needed.
  + In the “Higher education" section, fill out the fields accordingly and select “Now attending or Graduated” under "Degree status." Then, upload a current or recent unofficial or official transcript in English.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Currently enrolled in or graduated from a degree program within Product Management, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Internship or Teaching Assistant experience in product management, software development or a similar technical field.
* Experience leading entrepreneurial efforts or outreach within organizations while building cross-functional relationships.
* Experience preparing and delivering technical presentations to an audience through internships, coursework, or extracurriculars.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with methodologies aimed to drive product development and delivery.
* Experience applying Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) concepts to build products or features through relevant internship, capstone projects, or other academic work.
* Technical experience with programming languages, data analysis, business case/modeling, pricing, or design.
* Ability to start full-time in the primary cohort onboarding cycle between April and August 2027.
* Ability to communicate in English fluently to support cross-functional business relationships in the region.
* Excellent problem-solving, organizational, investigative, and critical thinking skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Google aims to build products that organize the world's information and make it universally accessible to our users. As a Product Manager at Google, you could be working on new technologies, platforms, consumer facing products, and/or enterprise systems. The end goal will be to match you with the team that best aligns with your interests, experience, and where you will have the most impact.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Understand markets and user requirements in depth.
* Launch products and features, test their performance, and iterate quickly.
* Work collaboratively with Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and User Experience (UX) on technologies.
* Develop innovative solutions to problems by collaborating as needed across regions, product areas, and functions.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager II - AI - Bangalore
job_description:
Role - Senior Product Manager || Job Location - Bangalore
  
  
About the Role
  
  
We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Product Manager / Senior Product Manager – AI to lead the strategy, development, and implementation of AI-driven products that transform customer and merchant experiences across our payments ecosystem. The role will work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Compliance, and Business teams to develop next-generation solutions powered by large language models (LLMs) and other generative AI technologies.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Define and drive the roadmap for generative AI capabilities across our product suite, including fraud detection, customer support automation, and personalised payment experiences.
  
Work cross-functionally with AI/ML Engineers, Data Scientists, UX Designers, and business stakeholders to build, launch, and iterate on AI-powered features.
  
Identify customer pain points and develop AI-first product solutions that improve efficiency, security, and user engagement.
  
Evaluate third-party LLM platforms, including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, and work with internal teams to integrate them securely and effectively.
  
Monitor product performance using data and customer feedback, and use insights to optimise AI models and user interactions.
  
Ensure that all AI product developments comply with applicable financial regulations and data privacy laws, including RBI and GDPR requirements.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
  
3–5 years of product management experience, including at least 1+ year of experience in AI products; experience in payments or fintech is highly preferred.
  
Strong understanding of generative AI models, including LLMs, transformers, and embeddings, and their applications in real-world products.
  
Proven track record of shipping B2C or B2B AI/ML-driven products at scale.
  
Strong analytical, strategic-thinking, and communication skills.
  
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with regulatory sensitivity.
  
  
Nice to Have
  
  
Experience with prompt engineering and fine-tuning LLMs.
  
Background in Data Science, Machine Learning, or Software Engineering.
  
Familiarity with payment ecosystems, risk modelling, and fraud analytics.
  
  
About PayU
  
  
At PayU, we’re building a world without financial borders where everyone can prosper. As a global fintech investor operating in 18+ high-growth markets, we extend financial services to underserved populations, help merchants thrive online, and invest in innovative financial technology. As part of Prosus, one of the world’s largest technology investors, we combine global expertise with local market knowledge to create meaningful impact. Learn more at www.payu.com
  
  
Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion
  
  
PayU fosters an environment where everyone belongs regardless of gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, or religious belief. Our leadership is committed to creating a transparent, flexible workplace where every voice matters and all PayUneers can succeed. We have zero tolerance for discrimination and actively promote equal opportunities across our global organization.

role: Senior Staff Product Manager - AI Agents (Migration & Onboarding)
role_title: Senior Staff Product Manager - AI Agents (Migration & Onboarding)
title: Senior Staff Product Manager - AI Agents (Migration & Onboarding)
job_description:
**Overview**
------------

Come join the QuickBooks Desktop team (part of Mid-Market Segment) as a Senior Staff Product Manager, AI Migration & Onboarding Agent.

QuickBooks is Intuit's flagship accounting software, powering millions of small and mid-sized businesses globally. The Mid-Market team is driving a critical transformation: migrating customers from Desktop to cloud-native platforms.

Today, migration from desktop to cloud is high-friction and high-touch. It slows conversion and strains support capacity. Your mission is to change that by building an AI Agent that guides customers through the entire migration journey, from readiness assessment to data migration, configuration, and first productive use.

This is a zero-to-one role. You will own the vision, strategy, and execution for this agent, working at the intersection of LLMs, agentic architectures, and accounting domain knowledge to turn migration from a barrier into a growth engine.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the AI Migration Agent end-to-end: Define vision, strategy, and roadmap for an AI agent that guides customers through complex product migrations, from readiness assessment through post-migration validation.
* Design for scalability and reuse: Architect the agent as a modular platform capability that can be extended to multiple source systems, customer segments, and net-new onboarding journeys.
* Define AI/Human collaboration: Design patterns where the agent handles routine tasks autonomously and escalates complex decisions to domain experts, support teams, or customers.
* Build the knowledge backbone: Own the agent's knowledge base, including product mapping logic, feature parity data, gap analysis rules, and domain-specific reasoning.
* Drive adoption and migration velocity: Define success metrics (completion rate, time-to-value, CSAT, support deflection) and build feedback loops to continuously improve agent performance.
* Lead cross-functional execution: Align engineering, AI/ML, design, data science, sales, care, and operations around an agent-first migration strategy. Partner with platform teams to leverage shared AI infrastructure.
* Close the customer insight loop: Research migrating customers, domain experts, and internal teams to uncover friction points and benchmark against AI-driven migration experiences in SaaS and Fintech.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 10+ years in product management with 2+ years shipping AI agent, conversational AI, or intelligent automation products in B2B SaaS or Fintech.
* AI Agent expertise: Deep understanding of agentic architectures, LLMs, RAG systems, orchestration frameworks, and evaluation pipelines. Experience defining guardrails, confidence thresholds, and human-in-the-loop escalation patterns.
* B2B SaaS Migration experience: Track record building customer migration, data portability, or onboarding products. Understands the complexity of moving business-critical data between systems at scale.
* Platform thinking: Designs modular, reusable agent capabilities that serve multiple source systems, customer segments, and journey types.
* Customer empathy: Deep experience with SMB/mid-market customers. Understands the friction and anxiety customers face when switching business-critical software.
* Analytical rigor: Comfortable defining and tracking agent performance metrics like accuracy, task completion, escalation rate, and time-to-value.
* Cross-functional influence: Proven ability to align engineering, AI/ML, design, and GTM teams around a shared product vision in a matrixed organization.
* Education: Undergraduate degree required (technical discipline preferred). MBA or advanced degree is preferred.

Preferred

* Hands-on experience with LLM-based agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and AI evaluation techniques.
* Experience in accounting, ERP, or financial software domains.
* Top-Tier or International MBA or other Advanced degree preferred.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager, Enterprise Solutions
job_description:
As a Product Manager in the APAC Products' cross-functional team, you will work on enabling AI-powered experiences for Enterprise customers, helping businesses transform how they engage with their audiences through intelligent solutions. This role is strategically important as you will shape the future of AI-enabled enterprise products in India/APAC. You will define new models for building, launching, and scaling AI-driven solutions that help enterprises automate workflows, personalize customer interactions, and unlock new business opportunities. You will partner with engineering, design, data science, and business teams to deliver meaningful AI-powered product experiences for enterprise clients. The team operates with close proximity to APAC markets, fostering strong partnerships. Expect a collaborative, people-centered environment with experienced teammates who value mentorship and knowledge sharing.This position offers a opportunity to shape AI-enabled enterprise products at global scale while being rooted in one of the world's most dynamic regions. If you're excited by bringing cutting-edge AI capabilities to enterprise customers and driving real business transformation, you'll thrive here.  
  
  

### **Product Manager, Enterprise Solutions Responsibilities:**

* Define and execute product roadmaps for AI-enabled enterprise experiences, including automation tools, intelligent workflows, and personalization capabilities
* Identify and drive consensus for how to prioritize and realize the most significant opportunities in your product area
* Lead cross-functional collaboration across engineering, design, data science, sales, and partnerships to deliver integrated solutions
* Drive go-to-market strategy for enterprise AI products in APAC markets, with potential for global expansion
* Scale AI best practices (including responsible AI use), workflows, and artifacts across product teams so the organization's capabilities compound over time
* Support the growth of other PMs and cross-functional team members by providing mentorship and coaching on AI-native practices
* Communicate product strategy and progress clearly and consistently to all stakeholders

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of Product Management experience
* 3+ years experience leading AI/ML product initiatives at scale (enterprise or B2B preferred)
* APAC market experience, as the role supports enterprise product strategy and go-to-market efforts across APAC markets
* Track record shipping products that drove measurable business outcomes for enterprise customers
* Experience developing and scaling AI-native strategies including evals and data strategies across teams
* Experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder environments and influencing without authority

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

job_description:
**Overview:** We are seeking a dynamic and experienced individual to join our team as a Product Manager in the Core HCM domain . In this role, you will be responsible for leading initiatives to streamline and improve Global HR processes, ultim ately enhancing efficiency, effectiveness, and employee experience across the organization in line with company policies and compliance.

**About this role:**

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Product Manager with deep expertise in Workday Core HCM to join the People Platforms team. In this role, you will own the product strategy and continuous improvement of our Core HCM capabilities across the Hire to Retire process (excluding the Hire process, which sits with the Talent Acquisition & Attraction (TAA) team), with particularly strong focus on the Change Job business process, as well as Termination and data management. You will also need working knowledge of Workday security and integrations to understand how changes in this space ripple across the wider Workday landscape. This is a strategic, solution-oriented position where you will collaborate with global leaders and cross-functional teams—including process owners, technology, security, and support functions—to accelerate implementation timelines, manage the product lifecycle, reduce operational issues, apply prioritization frameworks, and build a transparent, high-quality product roadmap.

The role is weighted roughly 50–70% product management and 50–30% process ownership; in practice the two are heavily intertwined, and the successful candidate will move fluidly between defining what we build and defining and standardizing how the underlying HR processes work.

**Key responsibilities**

**Product**

Product Strategy & Roadmap

* Define and execute a strategic product roadmap for Workday Core HCM aligned with organizational goals and evolving market needs, with a strong emphasis on the Change Job business process, Termination, and data management across the Hire to Retire lifecycle (excluding Hire, owned by TAA).

Feature Prioritization & Backlog Management

* Collaborate with process owners, technical teams, and business stakeholders to prioritize features and enhancements based on impact, feasibility, and user feedback; own and groom the product backlog in Jira (or equivalent).

Requirements & Development Oversight

* Translate business needs into clear product requirements, well-crafted user stories, and acceptance criteria. Lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle using agile methodologies, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.

Quality Assurance & Testing

* Partner with solution and QA teams to define test strategies—particularly for Change Job, Termination, and other core data change scenarios—and support testing efforts to ensure the reliability and performance of product releases.

Stakeholder Engagement & Product Evangelism

* Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for your products. Communicate the product vision, roadmap, and value proposition to stakeholders and end-users.

User-Centric Design & Feedback Loops

* Engage with users to gather insights, validate solutions, and drive continuous improvement through iterative feedback and data-driven decision-making.

Training & Change Enablement

* Collaborate with change management teams to develop training materials, user guides, and communication plans that support adoption and maximize product value.

Security & Integrations Awareness

* Work with security and integration teams to understand the downstream and upstream impact of Core HCM changes (e.g., Change Job, Termination, data changes) on business process security, access, and integrations, ensuring product decisions account for these implications.

**Process**

Process Design & Documentation

* Conduct comprehensive assessments of current Hire to Retire processes (excluding Hire), particularly Change Job, Termination, and related data management workflows, to identify areas for improvement and optimization.

* Develop, implement, and maintain process documentation and guidelines, ensuring these are scalable and adaptable across regions and business units, and are clearly reflected in the supporting Workday configuration.

Process Standardization

* Develop and maintain global standards for Change Job, Termination, and data management processes to enable consistency and compliance across all regions.

* Conduct regular checks to identify variances and areas for optimization, and facilitate the sharing of best practices across regions.

Process Simplification & Automation

* Use data-driven insight (including process mining where available) to identify complex, redundant, or unnecessary steps in Change Job, Termination, and data management processes, and redesign them to remove bottlenecks and reduce errors.

* Identify opportunities to automate manual tasks and evaluate technology solutions that streamline processes and enhance the employee and HR user experience.

Continuous Improvement

* Implement continuous improvement initiatives—drawing on methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen where relevant—and define metrics and KPIs to measure process performance and track progress.

Change Management & Compliance

* Lead process change management activities tied to product releases, including training, documentation, and progress monitoring.

* Ensure Change Job, Termination, and data management processes comply with relevant data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements; support audits and help implement corrective actions where gaps are identified .

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (preferred).

* Minimum 7 years of experience as a Digital or Software Product Manager and/or Process Owner in the HR Technology domain.

* Deep, hands-on expertise in Workday Core HCM, with demonstrated strong expertise in the Change Job business process specifically; solid working knowledge of Termination and data management processes.

* Broad working knowledge of Workday more generally, with the ability to understand how Core HCM changes interact with other modules.

* Working knowledge of Workday security (e.g., domain and business process security) and integrations, sufficient to identify downstream impacts and collaborate effectively with specialist teams.

* Strong understanding of HR processes and systems in large, global, and matrixed organizations, including the wider Hire to Retire lifecycle.

* Strong experience working with agile methodologies and tools such as Jira (or similar), including facilitating agile ceremonies (e.g., stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives).

* Demonstrated strength in crafting clear, well-structured user stories and acceptance criteria.

* Experience in process design, standardization, and continuous improvement; familiarity with methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen is a plus.

* Demonstrated ability to develop business cases for automation and process improvements.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.

* Experience working with industrial or frontline organizations (e.g., retail, manufacturing, logistics ) is a plus.

* Passion for innovation and driving meaningful change in the HR tech landscape.

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk.com .

title: Lead Product Owner / Product Manager
job_description:
**Date de publication :** Oct 29, 2026, 12:00AM
  
Join us at Orange Business!
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
  
**Role Overview:**  
We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Lead Product Owner / Product Manager to lead the development and enhancement of our flagship commercial ordering platform in international perimeter . The ideal candidate will drive product vision, prioritize features,perform requirement analysis and ensure seamless delivery to meet business needs and improve user experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Define and prioritize the product backlog aligning with business goals.
* Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, sales, and technical teams.
* Oversee end-to-end product lifecycle, including feature development, releases, and updates.
* Gather and analyze user feedback, market trends, and business requirements to inform product roadmap.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to validate solutions and ensure quality delivery.
* Team player
* Support compliance, audit requirements, and process improvements.
* Manage stakeholder communication, escalations, and issue resolution to ensure continuous service excellence.

**Qualifications:**  

* Proven experience in product management or ownership, preferably in commercial or ordering platforms.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to analyze complex requirements , propose quick win solution and translate them into actionable plans.
* Experience with backlog management, release planning, and cross-team collaboration.

We are seeking a proactive and strategic Lead Product Owner / Product Manager with proven experience in managing commercial or ordering platforms. The ideal candidate will possess strong stakeholder management skills, a deep understanding of product lifecycle management, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into actionable solutions. Experience in driving product roadmaps, prioritizing features, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions is essential. The candidate should be customer-focused, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities to ensure the continuous enhancement and success of the platform.
  
  
You bring a can-do attitude, tackle challenges head-on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.
  
  

* Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: Training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

Chez Orange, seules vos compétences comptent.
  
  
Quel que soit votre âge, genre, origine, parcours, religion, orientation sexuelle, handicap, neuroatypie, ou apparence, nous encourageons activement la diversité au sein de nos équipes, car elle constitue une force pour le collectif et un vecteur d’innovation.
  
  
**Orange est une entreprise handi-accueillante :** n’hésitez pas à nous faire part de vos besoins spécifiques.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product manager
job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**About the Team & Role**

Expedia Group’s Payments team is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the traveler payment experience, covering how travelers discover, select, and use payment methods at checkout. You’ll set strategy, prioritization, and experimentation for payment selection, flexibility, authorization performance, and recovery across web, mobile web, and native apps. The role blends deep payments expertise with AI product judgment to make payments simple, transparent, and trusted at global scale. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations, and brand teams.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

  

* Define and execute the product vision and roadmap for payment selection, payment method presentation, payment flexibility, and checkout interactions.
* Own the payment marketplace experience: decide which methods (cards, wallets, BNPL, local payment methods, installments) to surface, where, and for whom, by traveler, market, device, and trip context.
* Improve checkout conversion by removing friction across payment entry, authentication, authorization, error handling, retries, and recovery.
* Build a rigorous experimentation program, from hypothesis and A/B testing through measurement and scaled rollout of winners.
* Define and deliver AI capabilities such as personalized payment recommendations, intelligent routing, failure prediction, next-best-action recovery, and anomaly detection, partnering with Data Science and Engineering on model evaluation, explainability, privacy, bias, and safe rollout.
* Partner with Payments platform teams to ensure reliable, scalable, reusable capabilities across pay-in, authentication, orchestration, and payment status.
* Use quantitative and qualitative insights (conversion, payment and authentication success, support contacts, customer feedback) to prioritize opportunities and measure impact.
Balance traveler experience against cost, authorization performance, fraud and risk, regulatory needs, and operational efficiency, while aligning multiple EG brands and communicating strategy, risks, and decisions to senior leaders.  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

* 8 + years of product management experience, with a strong track record building, scaling, or transforming payment products.
* Expert knowledge of the payments ecosystem: payment methods, PSPs, authorization and declines, 3DS, tokenization, wallets, routing, refunds, and failure recovery.
* Proven success designing and optimizing high-converting checkout and payment-selection experiences across web, mobile web, and native apps, using experimentation, analytics, and customer research.
* Experience applying AI/ML to customer-facing products (personalization, decisioning, fraud prevention, optimization), with practical understanding of model evaluation, explainability, privacy, bias, and responsible rollout.
Excellent communication and ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organization, with strong analytical skills, product judgment on trade-offs, and a bias toward measurable outcomes.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience in travel, ecommerce, marketplaces, fintech, or other high-scale transactional businesses.
* Experience with payment orchestration, merchant-of-record models, payment performance optimization, or payment method expansion.
* Experience taking AI-powered products from problem definition and model evaluation through launch, monitoring, and measurable business impact.
* Familiarity with payment economics (processing costs, FX, rebates, routing, vendor performance) and global delivery across local payment methods, currencies, and regulations.
* Experience building products across multiple brands, regions, or business models, and improving post-booking payment experiences (payment updates, scheduled payments, failure recovery, payment status).

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Additional Locations:** India-Haryana, Gurgaon

**Diversity - Innovation - Caring - Global Collaboration - Winning Spirit - High Performance**

At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions.

**Location:**

Gurgaon

**About the position:**

Manage the commercial performance of the business from the point of view of revenue, market share and profitability. With additional inputs for strategic and Tactical planning, Project management, Product Life cycle management, Business Analytics, Budgeting and forecasting experience.

**Primary Job Functions:**

  

* Developing and implementing marketing plans for the country according to overall Urology plan and budget.
* Portfolio Strategy & business development planning
* Leading Product Launch and Life Cycle Management in collaboration with sales leadership, local and APAC/global cross-functional stakeholders.
* Analysis of competitor activities, customer needs, technology and infrastructure, therapy adoption etc. and implement Campaigns to drive Portfolio as per division’s goals.
* Engaging with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate and further the achievements of business goals.

**Job Responsibilities**

  

* Strategically managing all aspects of internal and external marketing strategy
* Conceptualize and Lead execution of marketing plans for Urology as per Business goals and budgets, coordinate with internal functions, customers and external service providers, monitor on ground execution of programs/ conferences/ events/ promotions etc the right set of metrics are in place for tracking success.
* Planning and implementing Product launches and Product life cycle management.
* Monitoring sales performance and effectiveness of marketing programs against goals set.
* Product Life cycle management and working with cross functional teams to drive product approvals, inventory planning and product availability as per portfolio marketing plans.
* Conduct analysis of competitor activities, customer needs, technology and infrastructure, therapy adoption
* Development of key marketing communications for portfolio, works closely with agencies and media to develop right messaging and its delivery, tracking the effectiveness of the communication to drive differentiation.
* Establish relationships with KOLs in the field, Drive KOL and customer engagement
* Conduct investigative research to assess brand image, market share and growth opportunities.

**Must Have:**

  

* MBA in marketing
* 5+ Years of exp is required in Medical devices and marketing. Experience of working in marketing / product management function.
* Candidate should have handled some product launches independently
* Strong interpersonal communication skills, written and presentation skills and the ability to manage multiple programs at once and effectively prioritize work are essential.
* Candidate should have experience in Product marketing & Digital marketing
* Proficiency in excel, power point and Microsoft tool
* Candidate with Sales experience or experience in Urology will be a preference but not a limitation
* Experience of working, interacting with KOLs / physicians.
* Experience of working with cross functional teams – finance, sales, regulatory, legal in a corporate environment
* Travel requirement approx. 7-10 days a month.

**Requisition ID:** 637135

Boston Scientific transforms lives through innovative medical technologies that improve the health of patients around the world. As a global medical technology leader for more than 45 years, we advance science for life by providing a broad range of high-performance solutions that address unmet patient needs and reduce the cost of healthcare. Our portfolio of devices and therapies helps physicians diagnose and treat complex cardiovascular, respiratory, digestive, oncological, neurological and urological diseases and conditions. Learn more at www.bostonscientific.com and follow us on LinkedIn.

title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Job Title: Product Manager**

**Location: Gurgaon, Onsite**

**Interview: Virtual**

**Experience: 8-12 Years**

**Employment Type: Full-Time**

**Budget: 25 LPA, Flexible**

**Local to NCR, Immediate Joiner (Serving Notice Only)**

**Preferred Previous MNC Exp**

Key Responsibilities

* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring features, initiatives, and user stories are clearly defined, refined, and prioritized.

* Define product roadmaps and priorities aligned with HNW (High Net Worth) business objectives and technology strategy.

* Collaborate with Business, Product, Technology, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, dependencies, and expected outcomes.

* Translate business needs and opportunities into actionable product requirements and measurable outcomes.

* Lead backlog refinement and prioritization in collaboration with Business Analysts, Product Owners, Technology teams, and Agile squads.

* Drive Agile execution and delivery by ensuring clarity of scope, acceptance criteria, priorities, and business outcomes.

* Facilitate stakeholder discussions to resolve competing priorities, requirements, and delivery dependencies.

* Track and communicate product progress, risks, dependencies, and key decisions to relevant stakeholders.

* Identify process improvement opportunities and establish meaningful metrics to measure product effectiveness and delivery performance.

* Partner with technology teams throughout solution design, development, testing, implementation, and post-production stabilization.

* Ensure end-to-end validation of delivered capabilities against business requirements and expected outcomes.

* Provide regular product updates, insights, and recommendations to senior stakeholders and leadership.

* Drive continuous improvement by incorporating feedback and lessons learned into future product planning and delivery.

Must-Have Skills

1. Life / Wealth Insurance Domain  
2. Product Backlog Management  
3. Stakeholder Management & Collaboration  
4. Agile Execution & Product Delivery  
5. Process Improvement & Metrics

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Graduate degree in B.E. / B.Tech. from a reputed university.

* 8–12 years of relevant professional experience.

* **Strong experience in Life Insurance or Wealth Insurance is mandatory.**

* Proven experience in Product Management, product delivery, backlog management, or a closely related role.

* Experience working in Agile environments with cross-functional business and technology teams.

* Agile/Product Management certification such as CSPO, PSPO, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, or equivalent is preferred.

Pay: ₹2,000,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

job_description:
Avam is an applied and materials sciences company developing biology, chemistry, and materials science products for testing, research, manufacturing, and cleaner energy applications. Working at the intersection of science and product development, the team focuses on bringing technically rigorous products to market that support customers across a range of scientific and industrial use cases.

This Product Manager role will help shape how Avam’s scientific product portfolio evolves to meet customer needs and market opportunities. You will work closely with technical and commercial partners to guide product direction, align priorities, and support decisions that balance scientific depth with business impact.

### **Responsibilities**

* Define product strategy and roadmap for Avam’s scientific product portfolio.
* Set priorities for Avam’s products and customer experiences, aligning the work with the organization’s mission and goals.
* Gather input from visitors, staff, and other stakeholders to understand needs and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Develop clear product plans, goals, and timelines, and keep work moving from idea through launch.
* Coordinate with teams across the organization to plan, deliver, and improve products, programs, or services.
* Define how success will be measured and track results such as customer feedback, participation, revenue, or other agreed-upon goals.
* Use research and performance data to recommend changes and guide future product decisions.
* Manage product budgets, schedules, and competing requests; raise risks or resource needs early.
* Keep stakeholders informed about priorities, progress, decisions, and results.
* Ensure products and experiences are accessible, consistent with Avam’s values, and useful to the people they serve.
* Document product decisions, processes, and lessons learned to support ongoing improvement.

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree or higher.
* 4+ years of product management experience in biotechnology or life sciences.
* Experience managing scientific products from discovery through commercial launch.
* Strong ability to translate technical concepts into actionable product requirements.
* Experience with scientific product areas or technical environments such as biotech research tools, diagnostics, lab instrumentation, manufacturing workflows, and cleaner-energy materials applications.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional collaboration across research, engineering, manufacturing, and commercial teams.
* Reliable high-speed internet connection for remote work.

job_description:
**Job Information**
-------------------

* Date Opened 27/10/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry Technology
* Work Experience 2-4 years
* City Noida
* Province Uttar Pradesh
* Country India
* Postal Code 201301

**Job Description**
-------------------

As a **Product Manager** at Rezo, you will own the complete product lifecycle: from understanding user needs and writing PRDs to managing design and development, launching features, and driving adoption. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who understands internal workflows and is equally comfortable building external modules that customers interact with directly. This is a high-impact role focused on delivering exceptional experiences for enterprise clients while enabling internal teams—from Sales to Analytics—to operate efficiently and at scale.

  

**Key responsibilities:**

• Product Strategy & Execution

- Define and manage the roadmap for customer-facing modules and internal tools that support delivery and operations.

- Translate business goals and user needs into structured product features and intuitive user journeys.

- Prioritize features based on impact, dependencies, and stakeholder feedback.

  

• Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Gather inputs and drive alignment across teams such as Sales, Project Delivery, Legal, Infra, Customer Success, and Analytics.

- Partner with Engineering to deliver high-quality features on time.

  

• User-Centered Development

- Conduct deep discovery with internal stakeholders and enterprise customers to identify pain points.

- Write detailed PRDs with clear workflows, success criteria, and edge cases.

- Create wireframes or collaborate with the design team to bring concepts to life.

  

• Platform Thinking

- Build scalable systems that work across geographies, teams, and industries.

- Establish feedback loops to continuously evolve internal and external tools.

  

• Analytics & Quality

- Monitor platform metrics, customer behavior, and operational performance to identify improvement areas.

- Collaborate with analytics teams to track adoption, identify friction points, and recommend interventions.

  

### **Requirements**

Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, Computer Science, or related field.

  

Experience

* 2–4 years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, preferably across platforms, internal tools, and customer-facing products.

  

Functional Skills
  
- Proven ability to write high-quality PRDs and lead cross-functional teams.

- Strong systems thinking with experience designing tools that enhance operational productivity.

- Exposure to customer lifecycle workflows, data dashboards, or service automation is a plus.

- Proficiency in JIRA, Figma, Confluence, or similar tools.

  

Behavioral Skills & Attitude

- Customer-Centric Mindset – Prioritizes customer satisfaction and proactive engagement.

- Proactive Approach – Anticipates issues and takes ownership to resolve them.

- Communication Skills – Communicates clearly and persuasively with stakeholders.

- Interpersonal Skills – Builds strong relationships and fosters trust.
